<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Interior specifications" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ManufacturedParts" name="Manufactured parts" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Plane delivery" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" />

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams, including the Russian vodka-bar and Irish whiskey-bar teams" processRef="Process_ManufacturingTeams" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Interior specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Start_ReceiveRequirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ManufacturedParts" name="Manufactured parts" sourceRef="Task_SendParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" messageRef="Message_ManufacturedParts" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Plane delivery" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceivePlane" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer customization and delivery confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin customization" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SpecifyInterior" name="Specify bar choice from five options, seat count, color, and toilet water amount" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send interior specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePlane" name="Receive plane" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SpecifyInterior" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SpecifyInterior" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceivePlane" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePlane" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" name="Interior specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Produce base airplane and customized parts" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceBaseAirplane" name="Produce base airplane" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_ManufacturedParts" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionJoin" name="Base airplane and parts ready" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightSplit" name="Conduct flight and create protocol" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightJoin" name="Flight and protocol complete" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver plane to customer" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Producer" name="Delivery confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_2" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_ProduceBaseAirplane" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_5" sourceRef="Task_ProduceBaseAirplane" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_7" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_8" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_9" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" targetRef="Task_TestFlight" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_11" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_FlightJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_12" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_FlightJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_13" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_14" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_15" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_16" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_Producer" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacture customized parts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveRequirements" name="Manufacturing requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Requirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureParts" name="Manufacture requested parts" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendParts" name="Send manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_ManufacturedParts" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ManufacturingTeams" name="Parts sent" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveRequirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_2" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureParts" targetRef="Task_SendParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_3" sourceRef="Task_SendParts" targetRef="End_ManufacturingTeams" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
